scope: backend/src/kloel/mind/** plus adjacent root services backend/src/kloel/mind.service.ts, mind-prediction (root of mind/), and legacy backend/src/kloel/kloel-global-prior.service.ts
domainsCovered: policy (epsilon-greedy + bandit decisions, guards, global-prior mixing, decision catalog)
memory (case-based reasoning, long-term graph consolidation, episodes, concepts, workspace tick-state, global priors, conversation archive, KV aliases)
runtime/coordination (tick scheduler + BullMQ processors, event spine + outbox, capability registry/executor, Brain decide/observe orchestrator, lead/whatsapp coordinators)
self-model / consciousness / self-evolution (versioned self-model, self-narrative, read-only self-modification proposer)
cia (autonomous agent runtime: bootstrap, backlog runs, inline fallback, cognitive health, chat filter)
knowledge (knowledge base, vector store, media factory, hidden-data extractor, agent-assist)
observability (lift report, daily report, spine audit, mind observability)
emergent cognition (autonomy goals, curiosity gaps, emotional intelligence, causal model)

canonicalEntities.name: MindBelief
canonicalEntities.role: Per-(subject,predicate,context) Beta-posterior belief (mean/variance/alpha/beta/samples). Canonical belief store of the inference loop.

canonicalEntities.name: MindPrediction
canonicalEntities.role: Open prediction with predictedMean/variance, horizon, deadline; resolved with actual+surprise. Canonical prediction ledger.

canonicalEntities.name: MindPolicy
canonicalEntities.role: Decision record: candidates/chosen/baseline, epsilon, utilities, calcSteps, outcome. Canonical policy/decision audit.

canonicalEntities.name: MindWorkspaceState
canonicalEntities.role: Per-workspace tick singleton: watermark, tick lease owner/until, tickCount, surpriseWindow, openDecisions, health. Drives the tick loop.

canonicalEntities.name: MindCase
canonicalEntities.role: Case-based reasoning store (text/tokens/features/action/outcome). Canonical episodic case memory.

canonicalEntities.name: MindConceptDetection
canonicalEntities.role: Detected concept with confidence/evidence/features. Canonical concept-detection store.

canonicalEntities.name: MindGraphNode
canonicalEntities.role: Semantic/long-term-memory graph node (kind/label/weight/metadata). Canonical knowledge-graph node store.

canonicalEntities.name: MindGraphEdge
canonicalEntities.role: Weighted typed edge between MindGraphNodes (relation/weight/samples). Canonical knowledge-graph edge store.

canonicalEntities.name: MindOutboxEvent
canonicalEntities.role: Transactional outbox with idempotencyKey/status/attempts/dispatchedAt. Canonical reliable commercial-event sink for the event spine.

canonicalEntities.name: MindBanditArm
canonicalEntities.role: Thompson-sampling bandit arm (alpha/beta/pulls/wins, isActive, promotedAt) per (workspace,decisionType,arm). Canonical exploration store.

canonicalEntities.name: MindGuardAudit
canonicalEntities.role: Guard decision audit (guardName/action/decision/allowed/reason). Canonical policy-guard audit trail.

canonicalEntities.name: MindDailyReport
canonicalEntities.role: One report row per (workspace,reportDate) with content+metrics. Canonical daily cognitive report.

canonicalEntities.name: MindGlobalPrior
canonicalEntities.role: Cross-workspace anonymized prior by (domain,predicate,context) mean/variance/samples. Canonical global-prior store (supersedes KloelGlobalPrior).

canonicalEntities.name: MindSelfModel
canonicalEntities.role: Append-only versioned self-model timeline (beliefsAboutSelf/decisionPatterns/knownLimits/contradictions). Canonical self-model history.

canonicalEntities.name: MindMessage
canonicalEntities.role: Canonical unified message store with source discriminator (brain|dashboard|lead_conversation). WRITE-ONLY today: dual-written from inbox/chat/thread/lead-processor but has NO read consumer (see legacyOrDead). Schema comment claiming 'ZERO writers' is now stale.

canonicalEntities.name: MindMemory
canonicalEntities.role: Canonical unified KV/semantic memory with namespace partition + vector(1536). Dual-written AND read by kloel-memory-engine.service.ts. Schema comment claiming 'canonical-but-dead / ZERO writers' is stale.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelMemory
canonicalEntities.role: Legacy KV/semantic memory table; still the PRIMARY surface (~89+ callers via prisma.kloelMemory and MindMemoryItemService.items). @deprecated in schema in favor of MindMemory but remains the source of truth.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelMessage
canonicalEntities.role: Legacy brain message table; still actively read (kloel-conversation-store, state-builder) via MindMessageService. Slated to converge into MindMessage(source='brain').

canonicalEntities.name: KloelGlobalPrior
canonicalEntities.role: @deprecated legacy per-(channel,decisionType,action) Beta prior. Superseded by MindGlobalPrior; its service has ZERO injectors (dead provider).

services.name: MindService
services.responsibility: Owns tick(): the WIRED production cognitive loop. Acquires tick lease, reads perception.since, runs MindEventProcessorService.process per event (predict->belief->surprise->update), sweeps expired surprise + policy outcomes, records workspace state. Also fronts decision-resolver helpers.

services.name: MindProcessorService
services.responsibility: BullMQ scheduler+tick workers (queues 'mind-scheduler','mind-tick'). Fans out to active workspaces every 30s, calls mind.tick(), fires emergent behaviors (autonomy/curiosity/longTermMemory/selfModel) + daily report.

services.name: MindBackgroundScheduler
services.responsibility: SECOND BullMQ scheduler (queue 'mind-bg-tick', 5s) + @Cron fallback. Drives MindBackgroundProcessor.tick for the hebbian/consolidation/valence substrate. Parallel to MindProcessorService.

services.name: MindBackgroundProcessor
services.responsibility: Stateless substrate tick: multi-timescale coordinator + hebbian decay + consolidation.runCycle + valence aggregate; ALSO fires MindPredictionService.runCycle. Parallel substrate to MindService.tick.

services.name: MindPerceptionService
services.responsibility: Reads percept events since watermark from RAC_AutopilotEvent, RAC_Message, RAC_KloelSale, CheckoutOrder, Product. perceive() normalizes a single input.

services.name: MindMultiModalPerceptionService
services.responsibility: Audio/image/structured perception; captureToCaseMemory writes directly to prisma.mindCase (bypasses MindCaseMemoryService). Emits cognition.perception.multimodal_observed.

services.name: MindBeliefService
services.responsibility: getOrInit + observeBinary Beta-posterior updates over RAC_MindBelief; list/getActiveBeliefs.

services.name: MindPredictorService
services.responsibility: predictReply/predictConversion/predict persist RAC_MindPrediction rows; findOpen/listResolved/resolve. Canonical DB-backed predictor.

services.name: MindPredictionService
services.responsibility: PARALLEL in-memory predictive-coding engine: runCycle reads RAC_AutopilotEvent, keeps an in-process activePredictions[] array, emits mind.prediction.generate/surprise back to RAC_AutopilotEvent. Does NOT use MindPrediction table. Linear surprise=confidence.

services.name: MindSurpriseService
services.responsibility: Information-theoretic surprise -log(p): resolveBinary/resolveReply, sweepExpired (deadline-miss penalty), computeSurprise. Canonical surprise math.

services.name: MindPolicyService
services.responsibility: choose (epsilon-greedy + bandit + global-prior mix), resolveOutcome, resolveOpenForSubject, sweepExpiredOutcomes, confirmAutopilotOutcome, harness. Persists RAC_MindPolicy.

services.name: MindBanditService
services.responsibility: Thompson-sampling over RAC_MindBanditArm (pull/update/promote arms).

services.name: MindGuardsService
services.responsibility: Policy guards; writes RAC_MindGuardAudit.

services.name: MindGlobalPriorService
services.responsibility: Canonical global priors over RAC_MindGlobalPrior: getPrior/lookupPrior/getPriorFor/getPriorTuple/recordObservation/listTopPriors/persistPriorSnapshot. Provides bridge methods replacing KloelGlobalPriorService.

services.name: KloelGlobalPriorService
services.responsibility: @deprecated legacy global prior over RAC_KloelGlobalPrior (getPrior/recordObservation). Registered in kloel.module but NOT injected by any consumer (dead).

services.name: MindCaseMemoryService
services.responsibility: Canonical case memory over RAC_MindCase: recordCase/findSimilarCases/similar. Token-overlap retrieval.

services.name: MindConceptService
services.responsibility: detect/recent over RAC_MindConceptDetection.

services.name: LongTermMemoryService
services.responsibility: Spine-event-driven FACT consolidation into RAC_MindGraphNode (consolidateFact, recallRelevant). Injected by kloel-reply-engine.

services.name: MindLongTermMemoryService
services.responsibility: consolidate(): tick-driven CASE->belief consolidation + pruning; emits cognition.memory.consolidated. Injected by MindProcessorService. DISTINCT store/trigger from LongTermMemoryService despite near-identical name.

services.name: ConsolidationService
services.responsibility: runCycle working-memory consolidation in the mind-bg substrate (a THIRD 'consolidation' surface).

services.name: EpisodeService
services.responsibility: Episodic memory; delegates writes to MindCaseMemoryService.recordCase.

services.name: ConversationArchiveService
services.responsibility: Conversation archival.

services.name: MindWorkspaceStateService
services.responsibility: Tick-lease acquire/release, watermark, recordSuccess over RAC_MindWorkspaceState.

services.name: MindEventProcessorService
services.responsibility: process(percept): per-event predict->resolve->surprise->belief pipeline (processMessageSent/Received/CheckoutStarted/Closed/AutopilotOutcome). The actual per-event loop body invoked by MindService.tick.

services.name: MindEventProcessorService(runtime/mind-event-processor)
services.responsibility: (see above)

services.name: MindReplayService
services.responsibility: Event replay for the runtime.

services.name: MindRuntime
services.responsibility: Brain decide()/observe()/streamDecisionEvents orchestrator: routes chat to UnifiedAgentService or operator capabilities, persists threads, records events via MindEventSpine. Aliased as deprecated BrainRuntimeService.

services.name: MindEventSpine
services.responsibility: record() -> writes RAC_AutopilotEvent; recordCommercial()/recordMany() -> writes RAC_MindOutboxEvent (idempotent). TWO event sinks in one service.

services.name: MindEventIngestor
services.responsibility: processDecisions/tickAllWorkspaces — a THIRD workspace-fanout/decision driver alongside MindProcessorService and MindBackgroundScheduler.

services.name: MindCapabilityExecutor
services.responsibility: Executes operator capabilities (listProducts/searchContact/sendMessageViaChannel/queryRevenueSummary/inspectSelf/searchCode/readSourceFile/runSafeQuery...).

services.name: MindCapabilityRegistry
services.responsibility: Lists/groups capabilities, allowedFor(source).

services.name: MindCommercialGraph
services.responsibility: recommendNextActions commercial-graph recommendations.

services.name: LeadMindCoordinatorService
services.responsibility: Coordinates Mind cognition for lead pipeline.

services.name: WhatsappMindCoordinatorService
services.responsibility: Coordinates Mind cognition for WhatsApp channel.

services.name: CommerceOutcomeLearnerService
services.responsibility: Learns commerce outcomes back into policy/priors.

services.name: MindSelfModelService
services.responsibility: snapshot(): derives + appends a versioned RAC_MindSelfModel row each tick, recording contradictions vs prior.

services.name: MindConsciousnessService
services.responsibility: getSelfNarrative/recordExperience/selfAssess — a self-narrative/health layer reading goals/experiences/limits. Overlaps self-model concept.

services.name: MindSelfModificationService
services.responsibility: Read-only self-improvement proposer: mines MindPrediction surprise>0.7, finds unreferenced files, emits cognition.self.modification_proposed. Never writes source.

services.name: MindAutonomyService
services.responsibility: proposeGoal() emergent goal proposal; emits cognition.autonomy.goal_proposed.

services.name: MindCuriosityService
services.responsibility: identifyKnowledgeGap(); emits cognition.curiosity.gap_identified.

services.name: MindEmotionalIntelligenceService
services.responsibility: Emotional inference; emits cognition.emotional.inferred.

services.name: MindCausalModelService
services.responsibility: Causal inference using MindSurpriseService.computeSurprise; emits cognition.causal.inferred/edge_reinforced/simulated.

services.name: AttentionService
services.responsibility: Attention salience in the mind-bg substrate.

services.name: HebbianService
services.responsibility: Hebbian association strengthen/decay in mind-bg substrate.

services.name: ValenceTaggerService
services.responsibility: Tags events with valence.

services.name: ValenceAggregatorService
services.responsibility: Aggregates valence into mood.

services.name: MultiTimescaleCoordinator
services.responsibility: Rate-limits substrate firing per timescale.

services.name: MindCanonicalService
services.responsibility: Brain->Mind Phase-1 facade: getConversationHistory/appendMessage/getMemoryItem/upsertMemory/recordCase/recordPolicy/addGraphNode over alias services + direct prisma.mindCase. Single canonical vocabulary.

services.name: MindMemoryItemService
services.responsibility: Typed alias over prisma.kloelMemory (RAC_KloelMemory); upsert optionally dual-writes RAC_MindMemory behind KLOEL_MINDMEMORY_DUALWRITE.

services.name: MindMessageService
services.responsibility: Typed alias over prisma.kloelMessage (RAC_KloelMessage): getHistory/appendToConversation/listByWorkspace. Read by kloel-conversation-store + state-builder.

services.name: MindChatMessageService
services.responsibility: Typed alias over prisma.chatMessage (RAC_ChatMessage) — separate dashboard table.

services.name: CiaRuntimeService
services.responsibility: Autonomous-agent runtime: orchestrates bootstrap, backlog runs, live autonomy presence heartbeats; drives MindBackgroundScheduler. A SEPARATE runtime from MindRuntime.

services.name: CiaService
services.responsibility: CIA chat/agent service surface.

services.name: CiaInlineFallbackService
services.responsibility: Inline fallback processing when async runtime is cold.

services.name: CiaCognitiveHealthService
services.responsibility: Cognitive-health scoring via goalField.runCycle.

services.name: MindReportService
services.responsibility: generateDaily writes RAC_MindDailyReport.

services.name: MindLiftReportService
services.responsibility: Lift/uplift reporting on policy vs baseline outcomes.

services.name: MindObservabilityService
services.responsibility: Observe-reply metrics/observability.

services.name: MindSpineAuditService
services.responsibility: Audits the event spine/outbox.

services.name: MindSimulatorService
services.responsibility: Synthetic world simulation.

services.name: MindSyntheticGeneratorService
services.responsibility: Generates synthetic training cases.

services.name: MindVerbalizerService
services.responsibility: Verbalizes internal mind state to natural language.

capabilities.name: memory KV store
capabilities.canonicalHome: KloelMemory/RAC_KloelMemory via MindMemoryItemService (backend/src/kloel/mind/aliases/mind-memory-item.service.ts:24) — current source of truth
duplicatedIn: MindMemory/RAC_MindMemory (canonical target, dual-write behind flag + read by kloel-memory-engine.service.ts)

capabilities.name: autonomous-agent runtime
duplicatedIn: MindRuntime (decide/observe orchestrator, mind-runtime.service.ts:52) — overlapping 'runtime' responsibility, different entrypoints

duplications.concept: Cognitive loop (perceive->predict->belief->surprise->policy->update) implemented THREE+ times with divergent storage
duplications.canonicalChoice: MindService.tick + MindEventProcessorService (the only DB-persisted, lease-coordinated, prediction-table-backed loop)
duplications.note: MindPredictionService claims in its header to 'CLOSE the cognitive loop perception->prediction->surprise->update' but it persists NOTHING to RAC_MindPrediction — predictions live in a process-local array lost on restart, and it computes surprise with a different (linear) formula than MindSurpriseService. Two independent loops both labeled 'the cognitive loop' is a correctness/maintenance hazard in prod: learning split across two stores that never reconcile.

duplications.canonicalChoice: MindSurpriseService.computeSurprise (information-theoretic, used by belief update + causal model)
duplications.note: Same named concept 'surprise' yields different magnitudes/units depending on which loop fired; downstream thresholds (e.g. self-modification surprise>0.7) become ambiguous.

duplications.concept: Two BullMQ tick schedulers fanning out the same active-workspace set
duplications.canonicalChoice: MindProcessorService for the persisted cognitive tick; demote mind-bg to a clearly-scoped 'substrate' sub-tick or fold in
duplications.note: Two independent schedulers each enumerate active workspaces and run overlapping cognition on different cadences (5s vs 30s). Risk of double work, Redis queue sprawl, and unclear ownership of 'who ticks a workspace'.

duplications.concept: Event spine has TWO physical event sinks
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindOutboxEvent (transactional, idempotent, dispatchable) as the single spine sink
duplications.note: Generic brain/cognition events land in the legacy RAC_AutopilotEvent table (no idempotency/outbox dispatch), while only 'commercial' events get the reliable outbox. Perception even READS percepts back out of RAC_AutopilotEvent — so the spine is simultaneously the legacy event log and the new outbox.

duplications.concept: MindGlobalPrior vs KloelGlobalPrior — two global-prior tables+services for the same capability
implementations: MindGlobalPriorService over RAC_MindGlobalPrior (memory/mind-global-prior.service.ts:55) — canonical, has injectors via MindPolicyService.mixWithGlobalPrior
KloelGlobalPriorService over RAC_KloelGlobalPrior (kloel-global-prior.service.ts:32) — @deprecated, registered in kloel.module but ZERO constructor injectors
duplications.note: KloelGlobalPriorService is dead code (provider with no consumer). The MindGlobalPriorService bridge methods that were meant to replace it already exist and are wired. Safe to drop the service+provider; table drop is owner-gated.

duplications.concept: MindMemory vs KloelMemory — canonical memory table dual-written but legacy remains source of truth
implementations: RAC_KloelMemory via MindMemoryItemService.items (~89+ direct prisma.kloelMemory callers) — PRIMARY read+write
RAC_MindMemory dual-write behind KLOEL_MINDMEMORY_DUALWRITE (mind-memory-item.service.ts:96) + read by kloel-memory-engine.service.ts:232/282/192
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindMemory (target) — but migration is incomplete; RAC_KloelMemory still authoritative
duplications.note: Schema comment on MindMemory (schema.prisma:3872) says 'canonical-but-dead / ZERO writers' — this is STALE: there are 2 writers (mind-memory-item upsert, kloel-memory-engine upsert) and 2 readers (kloel-memory-engine findMany). Two memory tables partially populated with no backfill = split-brain risk if a key is written to one but read from the other.

duplications.concept: MindMessage canonical table is WRITE-ONLY (dual-written, never read)
implementations: WRITERS: inbox.service.ts:60, chat.service.ts:86, kloel-thread.service.ts:79, kloel-lead-processor-helpers.ts:161 (all prisma.mindMessage.create)
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindMessage (target) once a reader migration lands; today reads go to RAC_KloelMessage/RAC_ChatMessage via MindMessageService/MindChatMessageService
duplications.note: Dead-on-read canonical table accumulating rows behind dual-write flags with no consumer. Either wire reads or stop the writes to avoid an orphan growing table; schema comment claiming 'ZERO writers' is also stale here.

duplications.concept: recordCase capability bypassed by direct prisma.mindCase.create writers
duplications.note: EpisodeService and MindConsciousnessService correctly delegate to recordCase, but two services hand-roll prisma.mindCase.create, so any future invariant (token extraction, feature shaping, dedup) added to recordCase is silently skipped by those paths.

implementations: LongTermMemoryService (memory/long-term-memory.service.ts:51) — spine-event -> RAC_MindGraphNode fact consolidation + recallRelevant
duplications.canonicalChoice: Keep both but RENAME for intent (e.g. GraphFactMemoryService vs CaseConsolidationService); ConsolidationService is the substrate variant
duplications.note: Three 'consolidation'/'long-term-memory' surfaces with overlapping vocabulary but different stores/triggers; the near-identical names (LongTermMemoryService vs MindLongTermMemoryService) are a maintenance trap — a developer will wire the wrong one.

duplications.canonicalChoice: Distinct responsibilities — keep both but document the split (MindRuntime = synchronous decide/observe; CiaRuntime = async autonomy lifecycle)
duplications.note: Both call themselves 'runtime'; not true duplication but the overlapping name + the MindBackgroundScheduler dependency inside CiaRuntime blurs ownership of the autonomy tick.

duplications.canonicalChoice: MindSelfModelService for the persisted self-belief timeline; MindConsciousnessService as a read/narrative view over it
duplications.note: Consciousness collects goals/experiences/limits independently rather than reading the canonical RAC_MindSelfModel snapshot; light redundancy that could drift.
Intentional ADR-0013 Wave M1 4-week alias window; track for removal once DI tokens migrate.

legacyOrDead: KloelGlobalPriorService (backend/src/kloel/kloel-global-prior.service.ts:32) — @deprecated, registered as provider+export in kloel.module.ts:443/560 but has ZERO constructor injectors anywhere; effectively dead code kept only for the RAC_KloelGlobalPrior table.
RAC_KloelGlobalPrior table (schema.prisma:3897) — @deprecated, superseded by RAC_MindGlobalPrior; owner-gated drop pending.
RAC_MindMessage (schema.prisma:3849) — WRITE-ONLY: dual-written from inbox/chat/thread/lead-processor but has NO read consumer; orphan-on-read canonical table.

MindPredictionService activePredictions[] in-memory state (mind/mind-prediction.service.ts) — non-durable; lost on every process restart; not reconciled with RAC_MindPrediction. Functionally a shadow loop.

Schema comments on MindMemory (schema.prisma:3872) and MindMessage (3849) asserting 'ZERO writers / canonical-but-dead' are STALE — both now have writers; the docstrings are dead documentation that misleads.
BrainRuntimeService alias (mind-runtime.service.ts:438) + backend/src/kloel/brain-runtime.service.ts shim — scheduled-for-removal compatibility layer (ADR-0013 Wave M1).

KloelMemory schema @deprecated note (schema.prisma:1711) points new code at MindMemoryItemService, yet RAC_KloelMemory remains the authoritative store — deprecation is aspirational, migration incomplete.
